objective: Add a strict durable task contract before read-only planning trials
nonGoals: Implement planner output or dependency-graph validation
Change GitHub workflows, pilot policy, or merge controls
acceptanceCriteria: WHEN task JSON enters the parser THEN duplicate keys, invalid fields, invalid types, and oversized payloads are rejected with TaskContractError
WHEN task fields are parsed THEN identity, state, risk, limits, paths, dependencies, and approval are validated without coercion
WHEN acceptance criteria are parsed THEN empty, duplicate, vague, and unstructured statements are rejected with TaskContractError
WHEN evidence mappings are parsed THEN unknown criteria and unapproved evidence sources are rejected with TaskContractError
WHEN task path claims are parsed THEN recovered roots, absolute paths, traversal, and overlapping scopes are rejected with TaskContractError
WHEN repository task fixtures are loaded THEN every task fixture validates against the same durable contract
WHEN the automated contract suite runs THEN tests complete without invoking a model
